pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena upāsakena saṃghaṃ uddissa vihāro kārāpito hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.3: so tassa vihārassa mahe ubhatosaṃghassa akālacīvaraṃ dātukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.4: tena kho pana samayena ubhatosaṃghassa kaṭhinaṃ atthataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.5: atha kho so upāsako saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā kaṭhinuddhāraṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.9: evañ ca pana bhikkhave kaṭhinaṃ uddharitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.12: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho kaṭhinaṃ uddhareyya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.16: yassāyasmato khamati kaṭhinassa uddhāro so tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.1: atha kho so upāsako bhikkhunīsaṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā kaṭhinuddhāraṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.5: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo amhākaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ na dassantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa upāsakassa . . . vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.8: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Thullanandā dhammikaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ paṭibāhissatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī . . . paṭibāhīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.15.1: yā pana bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ paṭibāheyya, pācittiyan ti. ||2||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:2.1.8: kathaṃ idaṃ kaṭhinaṃ uddhareyyā 'ti paṭibāhati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
